annotations.title: Split a CIDR block into smaller subnets

description: Split a CIDR block into smaller subnets. Lists the subnets of a given prefix length inside a parent block (e.g. a /16 into /24s), up to 4,096 per call, with the total count. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
